market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $90 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI today ~$96; April had highs above $110 and fell to ~$94 by Apr 25. Lows reportedly around $80.56 in March-April window but unclear if that print was during April or late March. With 2-3 trading days left in April and current price at $96, would need a 6%+ drop to close below $90. Market price 0.265 likely reflects similar uncertainty.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the cited $80.56 low actually occurred in April or in late March before market creation.
